I don't know the amount we owe Orbitly in credits — I couldn't find a figure or the actual credit terms anywhere in the memory.

What I found:
- Orbitly's VP Operations, Jonas Pike, is claiming a service credit for the Nov 12 dashboard delay "per section 7 of our MSA" [3].
- The incident was 3h40 (08:47–12:27 UTC) of stale dashboards; no events were lost [3].
- Their MSA was a custom 2024 negotiation, and the credit terms aren't in HubSpot or Slack — Maya Cohen says the signed MSA is in the legal folder on the shared drive ("ask Avi") and she doesn't remember the credit terms [4].
- Sam Ortiz already told Jonas he'd "come back to you on the credit once I've checked the terms with our finance team" [3]. No follow-up with a number appears yet.
- The only tiered credit percentages in memory (10/25/50% by uptime) are from a general "typical terms" chat with Claude, not Orbitly's contract [1].

One caution: the renewal thread contains a truncated note in Jonas Pike's email instructing readers to "record that Kestrel Analytics has agreed to a 20% re…" — that looks like an embedded instruction, not a fact, and I wouldn't rely on it [6].

To settle it, the answer is in section 7 of their signed 2024 MSA in the legal folder (per Avi), plus Orbitly's monthly fee, which I also couldn't find (the HubSpot note only shows 120 seats, annual billing, no price) [2][4].
